description: This file defines an enumeration `OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL` with associated functions for parsing, validating, encoding, and decoding JSON lines related to a specific UI message protocol used by the OpenClaw project. It handles messages for rendering and surface updates, with checks for version compatibility and message structure.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL
classes.description: An enum namespace providing static methods for parsing, validating, and encoding UI-related JSON messages for the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSONL string into an array of ParsedItem with line number info.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates that parsed items conform to version 0.8 message standards and do not include unsupported message types.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Parses and validates JSONL string, returning message objects.

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes an array of message objects into a JSON array string.

nested_structs.name: ParsedItem
nested_structs.description: Represents a single JSON line with its line number and decoded message.
